legs.name: claude
legs.note: Recommended Claude model/effort: R-ROSTER (the versionless `opus` alias, which the claude CLI and the native agent preset both accept). Explicit model overrides and null retain host selection semantics; agent names the native reviewer preset on A (required) and is passed as --agent on B when set. B's runnable default timeout is 1200 s.

legs.name: codex
legs.note: Recommended codex model/reasoning: R-ROSTER (shipped defaults carry the explicit ID until a codex alias is measured). An explicit null override retains host-default semantics and is frozen as null.

legs.note: Google route pin: google.route = agy or gemini; otherwise preserve the host's selection chain. Default Pro family with verifiable HIGH; model placeholders are replaced by the user's pin (a host's shipped default or the user's override), passed as written and never checked against a model list (R-MODEL). Adapter-specific timeout and effort support remain mandatory.
